text:
Nora: Heads up — ap-southeast1 has ~140 GPU pods stuck Pending after the scheduler rollout. Looks like a prebind/taint hang.
SRE-Bot: alert: cluster=gpu-prod-ap-southeast1 pending=142 severity=high dashboard=https://console/alerts/1750054321
Jin: I see many "prebind: waiting for taint-propagation" logs and kubelet attach queue saturation.
Marco: Which change rolled? The prebind-window increase to 10s landed last night.
Nora: Yes, thats the suspect. It's causing longer prebind waits that amplify region taint delays.
Ops: Starting a targeted rollback to ap-southeast1a canary now (will limit to 5 nodes).
Jin: Also recommend bumping nvattach-concurrency on kubelet from 3->8 in apac as a temporary measure.
SRE-Bot: rollback started at 1750054350.
Ops: Canary rollback completed for a. Pending dropped 142 -> 68 in ~80s. Rolling to b/c.
Marco: Good signal. After finishing rollback and a small attach-concurrency canary, pending dropped to ~20 and eviction churn stopped.
Nora: Follow-ups: add region-specific safety gating for prebind features, and make prebind-window dynamic based on taint-propagation p95. Filing INF ticket.
Jin: Also add an ops-runbook quick toggle to disable prebind per-region to speed future mitigation.
Ops: Incident marked mitigated at 1750054448. Monitoring for 30m.
